title: DeepSeek Leads $400M Seed Round for Winverse AI
summary:
A robotics company based in China is securing tens of millions of dollars in capital through a new investment from DeepSeek. The financing, which serves as a seed funding round, values Winverse AI at approximately $400 million post-money, according to sources reported by Bloomberg.

Winverse AI develops artificial intelligence for robotic systems. DeepSeek has agreed to act as the lead investor for the startup, providing the primary funding to support the company's early operations in the robotics AI sector.
